name: session-register
title: Session attendance register
for_each: select id,name from sessions order by starts_at

sections.title: Session
sections.sql: select name,starts_at,ends_at,status from sessions where id=$1
sections.note: Times are UTC. Record actual attendance only. This is a snapshot, not a live sign-in screen.

sections.title: Roll
sections.sql: select child,attendance_state,signed_in_at,signed_in_by,signed_out_at,collected_by from daily_roll where session_id=$1 order by child

name: emergency-list
title: Session emergency and collection list
for_each: select id,name from sessions order by starts_at

sections.title: Children and instructions
sections.sql: select c.name,c.medical_notes,c.medication_instructions,c.medication_plan,c.court_order_notes,c.safety_plan from bookings b join children c on c.id=b.child_id where b.session_id=$1 and b.status='confirmed' order by c.name
sections.note: Confidential. Give only to staff who need these records. Regenerate before an excursion.

sections.title: Contacts
sections.sql: select c.name as child,co.name as contact,co.phone,co.relationship,co.authorised_pickup from bookings b join children c on c.id=b.child_id join contacts co on co.child_id=c.id where b.session_id=$1 and b.status='confirmed' order by c.name,co.name

name: incident-report
title: Incident record for review
for_each: select id,details as name from incidents order by occurred_at

sections.title: Recorded incident
sections.sql: select c.name as child,s.name as session,i.occurred_at,i.location,i.details,i.injury,i.treatment,st.name as staff,i.parent_informed_at,i.confirmation,i.follow_up_due,i.status from incidents i join bookings b on b.id=i.booking_id join children c on c.id=b.child_id join sessions s on s.id=b.session_id join staff st on st.id=i.staff_id where i.id=$1
sections.note: A recorded acknowledgement is evidence supplied by the operator, not an electronic signature created by this software.

name: family-statement
title: Family account statement
for_each: select id,name from families order by name

sections.title: Invoices
sections.sql: select name,issued_on,due_on,currency,total_cents,paid_cents,total_cents-paid_cents as balance_cents from invoices where family_id=$1 and status='open' order by due_on
sections.note: Recorded balances only. No payment collection, bank reconciliation or subsidy claims.

name: drill-record
title: Programme drill record
for_each: select id,name from programmes order by starts_on

sections.title: Drills
sections.sql: select name,occurred_at,notes,recorded_by from drills where programme_id=$1 order by occurred_at
sections.note: An empty record means no drill has been entered. Do not infer that a drill occurred.
